title: Decision Models for Definition-Driven GitHub Actions Workflow Smell Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.31421v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GitHub Actions workflows automate continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), and workflow smells are recurring configuration patterns that may weaken security, hinder maintenance, or waste resources. Extending static analyzers to new smells requires encoding constructs, applicability conditions, and exceptions in detection rules. We investigate definition-driven detection, in which models assess workflows against reusable natural-language smell definitions, focusing on decision-oriented models that return scores for bounded questions. We compare them with generative models and a static analyzer, and examine their score reliability, repeatability, and robustness. We evaluate three decision-oriented and two generative configurations on 1,710 manually validated workflow-smell pairs covering 19 smells, 903 workflows, and 559 repositories. Effectiveness depends strongly on the decision policy: JEV 1.13 achieves 79.69% micro-F1 at threshold

translated_title: 面向定义驱动的 GitHub Actions 工作流坏味检测的决策模型
translated_abstract: GitHub Actions 工作流用于自动化持续集成与交付（CI/CD），而工作流坏味是指那些可能削弱安全性、阻碍维护或浪费资源的重复出现的配置模式。若要扩展静态分析器以检测新的坏味，则需要在检测规则中编码相关结构、适用条件和例外情况。我们研究了定义驱动的检测方法，即由模型依据可复用的自然语言坏味定义来评估工作流，重点关注面向决策的模型，这类模型针对有界问题返回评分。我们将其与生成式模型以及一个静态分析器进行比较，并考察其评分的可靠性、可重复性和鲁棒性。我们在 1,710 个经过人工验证的工作流坏味样本对上评估了三种面向决策的配置和两种生成式配置，这些样本覆盖 19 种坏味、903 个工作流和 559 个代码仓库。结果表明，检测有效性在很大程度上取决于决策策略：JEV 1.13 在相应阈值下达到 79.69% 的微平均 F1 值。
tldr: 本文提出用面向决策的模型依据可复用的自然语言坏味定义来检测 GitHub Actions 工作流坏味，发现检测效果高度依赖决策策略，其中 JEV 1.13 达到 79.69% 的微平均 F1，并在评分可靠性、可重复性和鲁棒性上表现更优。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates definition-driven GitHub Actions workflow smell detection using decision-oriented models that score bounded questions against reusable natural-language smell definitions, showing that effectiveness strongly depends on the decision policy, with JEV 1.13 achieving 79.69% micro-F1.
